An '''AEGIS nanoarray''' was a type of [[energy dispersion system]], a device designed to distribute energy across armor and ground it, which protected against electricity and stun weapons.<ref name="FDCR">''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook]]''</ref>
